about.title: A shop window for the account.
about.text: The feed does the introducing. This site holds the edit still long enough to choose.

sections.title: Thousands of people already watching. One place to send them.
paragraphs: Renovanest sits between an Instagram account and AliExpress. Stories and posts stay where the audience already is. The link in bio lands here: a home page, a filterable shop, and a page for each piece. The purchase itself is handed back to AliExpress.
Add a real piece from the admin: name, photos, price, and the AliExpress item link. The Buy button opens that link.

sections.title: What the button actually does.
paragraphs: Every piece has a Buy on AliExpress control. It opens a new tab. Paste the exact item URL in the product and the button goes there. If the URL is empty, it searches AliExpress for the fallback words.
An affiliate key in Brand settings is appended to that outbound link.

sections.title: The seller ships. Their policy returns.
paragraphs: Delivery times, tracking, and buyer protection are shown on AliExpress after you pick a seller. A photo here is not a promise about a parcel.
If something arrives wrong, start with the order on AliExpress. This storefront does not hold stock and does not process the refund.

faqs.q: Do I pay on this website?
faqs.a: No. This site is the lookbook and the shortlist. Buy on AliExpress opens their site, and that is where payment, address, and shipping are handled.
The price here is the edit’s reference. AliExpress prices move with the seller, shipping, and coupons. Trust the figure on their checkout.
Returns follow the AliExpress seller’s policy and AliExpress buyer protection. This storefront cannot issue that refund.
